proposedSingleNextDiagnostic.purpose: Distinguish actual retained JS/Node or Chromium embedder/backing buffers in main/shell from resident working-set oscillation; preserve separate native Codex opaque role, no claim of native heap attribution.
proposedSingleNextDiagnostic.workload: Use exact isolated C28 pinned package and official local 0.169.0 native executor, existing five task-backed pages and five real warm reads. One normal five-read batch after warmup, one after a true 300s idle with no new task/command; sample before, immediately after, and +15/+60/+180/+295s first idle, then second batch before/after/+15/+60s. Separate short diagnostic only, about six-to-seven minutes after warmup, no new formal 30-minute run.
proposedSingleNextDiagnostic.measurement: Reuse C23 public numeric heap endpoints: existing ElectronHarness mainEvaluate process.memoryUsage from exact own main, Runtime.getHeapUsage for exact trusted shell. In the private diagnostic collector, retain only additional numeric footprint/wired/pageins already returned by the same bound Native.Usage/proc_pid_rusage; no extra PID discovery or alternate acceptance metric. Read only real scope-closed per-PID RSS with page/doc proof, same fixed identity/time and record query duration. If authorized and overhead bounded, collect main/shell public V8 sampling allocation aggregates by project frame in this diagnostic only (no object values/raw memory; no GC trigger; not a formal endpoint). Observe live allocation lower envelope after natural collection and per-PID native RSS separately. Do not infer native cause from JS profile.
proposedSingleNextDiagnostic.decision: A new product repair only if repeated stable-time windows show positive retained main/shell live heap/external/backing of same service stack or explicit durable/listener/data structure count with source evidence and minimal regression test; test whether known remaining delegation timer prepares actually dominate an idle retained allocation, otherwise do not patch them; no correction based only on RSS or malloc reservation. If numeric heaps reclaim/are flat while RSS/native dominates, record classification as unresolved/runtime working set, no product root or forced release, stop additional blind long tests. Missing closure/attribution is still failure of diagnostic, no borrowed scope. Formal retest only once new justified fix or resolved measurement plan exists.
